title: Conditional cross-Q kernel and weight-recursion projective bridge
purpose: Formalize the exact finite algebra showing that a stochastic cross-Q component kernel plus its induced weight recursion preserves cylinder-mixture expectations and probability normalization. The kernel and weights remain future source-owned hypotheses.

lean.scope: Abstract finite fine/coarse index types, real component expectations, nonnegative stochastic kernel, and induced coarse weights. No PAH sector values or state are instantiated.

definitions: A fine component expectation is the kernel mixture of coarse component expectations.
Coarse weights are induced by the fine weights and row-stochastic kernel.
assumptions: Fine and coarse sector index types are finite.
The cross-Q kernel K(q_f,q_c) is nonnegative.
Every fine-kernel row sums to one.
Fine weights are nonnegative and sum to one.
Fine component push-forward expectations equal the K-weighted coarse component expectations.
theorem_contract.conclusion: The induced coarse weights are nonnegative and normalized, and the fine weighted mixture equals the coarse weighted mixture for every supplied component expectation vector.
not_supplied: No source-owned K_n(q_c | q_f) is supplied or shown to exist.
No PAH finite Gibbs component push-forward identity is supplied.
No cross-Q sector weight law, common cylinder topology, Cauchy error, or omega is constructed.
No R-484 boundary-error estimate, R-488 asymptotic witness, or stationarity domain is supplied.

non_claims: This packet proves an abstract finite algebraic implication only; it does not define PAH sector weights or a projective kernel.
It does not prove exact projectivity for PAH-OMC-014 because the component push-forward and kernel hypotheses are not supplied.
It does not prove weak cylinder convergence, positivity of an omega, R-488 nonvanishing, or omega(L f)=0.
No infinite-volume semigroup, quantum real-time, physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmological, or TOE conclusion follows.
